description: Arif Habib Corporation Limited (AHCL) is the holding company of the Arif Habib Group, one of Pakistan's business groups, and describes itself as the group's flagship company. Its portfolio is spread across fertilizers, financial services, construction materials, industrial metals, dairy farming and energy. The companies it lists under associates and subsidiaries include Fatima Fertilizer, Arif Habib Limited, Aisha Steel Mills, Javedan Corporation, Power Cement, Sachal Energy Development and Arif Habib Consultancy.
headOffice: Arif Habib Centre, 23, M.T. Khan Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan

products.name: Fatima Fertilizer Company Limited
products.summary: A fertilizer producer described by AHCL as a joint venture between the Fatima Group and the Arif Habib Group, with plants at Sadiqabad, Sheikhupura and Multan and total annual production capacity of 2.57 million tonnes.

products.name: Arif Habib Limited
products.summary: The group's securities brokerage and investment banking business, offering equity, fixed income, money market and forex brokerage and corporate advisory services.

products.name: Aisha Steel Mills Limited
products.summary: A publicly listed flat-rolled steel producer, described by AHCL as one of the key players in Pakistan's flat-rolled steel industry.

products.name: Power Cement Limited
products.summary: A cement producer located at Motorway M9, Nooriabad, Sindh, which manufactures and markets cement and exports clinker and cement.

products.name: Sachal Energy Development (Pvt.) Limited
products.summary: A clean-energy business that supplies power to the national grid through the National Transmission and Despatch Company.

products.name: Javedan Corporation Limited
products.summary: A group holding whose site — originally a cement plant — became the Naya Nazimabad housing society in Karachi.
